headlines.title: Iranian president claims they are 'victims of terrorism' in United Nations speech
headlines.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian used his address to the United Nations to draw attention to leaders, scientists and civilians who had been killed and accused the United States of "terrorism." NBC News' Matt Bradley reports on the leader's remarks and the ongoing conflict overseas.

headlines.title: White House Responds to Suit Filed by 3 News Outlets Over Ban
headlines.description: In a court filing by the Justice Department, the DOJ says media access to White House grounds is a privilege, not a right. It argues that CNN, MS NOW and Politico don’t deserve that access because “the president concluded that they have failed to maintain basic minimum ‘standards of professionalism and decorum.” The news outlets say the move violates their due process and their First Amendment right. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump Welcomes Xi Jinping After UNGA Speech Threatening Iran
headlines.description: During his address to the United Nations General Assembly on Tuesday, President Donald Trump issued a dire warning to Iran, saying “Will a deal be made with Iran? Or do I annihilate the Islamic Republic?” It comes as the president is set to welcome China’s Xi Jinping to the White House where the escalating AI competition will top their agenda. The visit, however, is drawing rare criticism from a top Republican. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: FBI investigating hacking group’s claim of massive breach of agent info
headlines.description: ShinyHunters, a cyber-extortion outfit, said that it had hacked into the FBI’s jobs portal and used that access to steal a major tranche of sensitive files.

headlines.title: New campaign aims to help millions at risk of losing Medicaid coverage under work requirements
headlines.description: On Jan. 1, new federal work and reporting requirements kick in for Medicaid, leaving millions at risk of losing healthcare coverage as states scramble to prepare for the most substantial change to the program in decades.

headlines.title: We want to hear about your experience with Tricare medical coverage
headlines.description: If you receive healthcare through the military benefits program, or if you are a Tricare employee or contractor, share your story.

headlines.title: Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in prison for sexual assault in New York case
headlines.description: Harvey Weinstein was sentenced to 15 years in prison, more than a year after a jury found the former Hollywood mogul guilty of sexually assaulting former “Project Runway” production assistant Miriam Haley in a high-stakes retrial. NBC News' Valerie Castro breaks down what happened during Weinstein's sentencing.

headlines.title: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart to undergo season-ending knee surgery, reports say
headlines.description: New York Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart will miss the rest of the season after injuring multiple ligaments in his left knee, according to multiple reports.

headlines.title: Netflix turns Willy Wonka’s chocolate factory into a real-life ‘social experiment’
headlines.description: Nods to the ‘Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory’ appear everywhere in Netflix’s new competition show ‘Wonka’s The Golden Ticket,’ including via the AI-generated voice of Gene Wilder

headlines.title: These young quarterbacks were supposed to break out. Now they’re hurt.
headlines.description: The New York Giants’ Jaxson Dart on Monday became the latest upstart QB to be sidelined with an injury, joining the Bears’ Caleb Williams and the Commanders’ Jayden Daniels as signal callers who had to leave the field early in Week 2.

headlines.title: Russia forced a Ukrainian soldier to make a propaganda video. His village refused to bury him.
headlines.description: Russia has coerced thousands of Ukrainian prisoners to denounce their leaders and country in propaganda videos. The consequences can follow them home.

headlines.title: Trump touts peace settlements he has brokered in remarks to United Nations
headlines.description: President Trump said it had been a "great honor" to help broker multiple peace deals between nations during his address to the United Nations General Assembly. The president also touted the praise and thanks he had received from the leaders involved in the deals.
